input: Test and replace all smoke detector batteries

gold.taskTitle: Test and replace all smoke detector batteries
gold.taskDescription: Test every smoke detector in the home and replace batteries where needed.

questions.title: How many smoke detectors are in your home?
questions.description: Knowing the total count helps estimate time, supplies, and coverage needed.

questions.title: What brand or battery size do your detectors require?
questions.description: Identifying the battery type (e.g., 9V, AA, lithium) ensures the right replacements are purchased.

questions.title: When were the batteries last replaced?
questions.description: Understanding the replacement history clarifies urgency and whether all units need new batteries or just some.

questions.title: Do you already have replacement batteries at home?
questions.description: Knowing if batteries need to be purchased first determines whether a store trip is part of the plan.

questions.title: Are any detectors located in hard-to-reach places?
questions.description: High ceilings or awkward locations may require a ladder or additional help, affecting preparation.

questions.title: Do any detectors show a low-battery warning right now?
questions.description: Knowing which units are already signaling helps prioritize the order of replacement.

questions.title: Is there a specific deadline you want this done by?
questions.description: A target date or urgency level helps structure a realistic timeline for completing the task.
